parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate a token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the value of **RequestId** as the **client token**. The value of **RequestId** is different for each API request.

parameters.name: Ipv6EgressOnlyRuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the egress-only rule that you want to delete.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the IPv6 gateway. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~448570~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc delete-ipv6-egress-only-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv6-egress-only-rule-id ipv6py-hp3w98rmlbqp0xxxxxxxx --client-token 123456 --dry-run true --region cn-hangzhou
